name: Kandima, Sublime Hatred
text:
Fanfare: Summon a copy each of 2 random differently named allied amulets destroyed this match with Last Words and a base cost of 2 or less.

Super-Evolve: Select another card on the field and destroy it. If you selected an allied amulet, deal 3 damage to all enemy followers.
